steps.name: Reject source drift and preserve original overlay and logging controls
steps.run: python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_closed_network tools.tests.test_go_runtime_overlay tools.tests.test_go_managed_idle tools.tests.test_go_standard_logging -v

steps.name: Authenticate the maintained upstream compiler
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
out="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-closed-network-tools"
test ! -e "$out"
mkdir "$out"
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 180 --output "$out/go.tar.gz" https://dl.google.com/go/go1.27.3.linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "65efbc80fdc1fa2cd2631cad5b481777a68e8725f34e89f50fc6ac714e379b40  $out/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$out/go.tar.gz" -C "$out"
echo "$out/go/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
